user.title: Set up NIBE Local REST
user.description: Connect to the local NIBE REST API.

data_description.password: The password is shown as a masked value.

reauth_confirm.title: NIBE Local REST – update credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The NIBE rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current credentials. Leave the password or Authorization header field empty to keep the stored value.

init.title: Configure NIBE Local REST
init.description: Change the host, credentials, and polling interval. Password and Authorization header are not displayed; leave either field empty to keep the stored value.
